name: FeTA 2024 challenge
description: A challenge dataset and evaluation for automated fetal brain MRI segmentation and biometric measurements.
reputation: FeTA is a recognized challenge within the fetal MRI segmentation community for benchmarking automated fetal brain segmentation and measurements.
notes: Clinical datasets can have scanner/site variability and limited sample sizes per pathology; evaluation typically focuses on segmentation metrics (Dice/Hausdorff). Non-LLM benchmark; careful attention needed for inter-rater variability in ground truth.
